scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and exact-arithmetic checker; finite probes supplement but do not establish universal or asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Exact for CNBLD and left-shifted SCNBLD only; a separate CNBSLD family is not included. Global-mode threshold is an attained integer minimum and isolated modal plateaus can occur. Priority is best-knowledge, not independently guaranteed.
title: Sharp bimodality chamber and two critical shape scales for negative-binomial–logarithmic conflation
